component.name: Noesis Ebook Translator
component.summary: Translate EPUB ebooks while keeping formatting, index and illustrations

description.p: Noesis Ebook Translator is a desktop application that translates EPUB books with the Ebook Translator engine, preserving inline markup, links, anchors, the table of contents and illustrations.
It includes a reader, chapter selection, translation cache with resume, cost estimation, and export to EPUB, HTML, Markdown, text, JSON, CSV, DOCX and PDF.
